_matrixAnalyse: This ad group has the clearest graduate-level signal of any in the account. 'Masters in artificial intelligence' (55 clk, CVR 17.3%) is the top converter — the highest CVR in this theme, confirming the audience expects a postgraduate-level programme. 'Artificial intelligence course' (59 clk, CVR 12.7%) and 'AI course' (8 clk, CVR 25.0%) are strong secondary converters. 'AI engineer' (22 clk, CVR 4.5%) confirms the career angle. Pattern B : 'AI bootcamp' (5 clk, CVR 0%) and 'artificial intelligence free online' (3 clk, CVR 0%) do not convert — this audience is not looking for a casual intro. The page must match the ambition of the audience : real ML engineering, production deployment, not AI tools for non-techies.
